purpose: Reply-template registry (not ranking weights or OKF ingestion schema)
variable_syntax: {placeholder} must be populated only with verified values or an explicit unknown/not_reported marker
implementation: Route intents to 1 primary template, compose optional secondary templates; populate using provenance-backed OKF fields; validate every citation before rendering.
global_rules: Answer the exact user question before adding context; prefer researcher-friendly language, not marketing claims.
Use real author/title/year/DOI and citations bound to retrieved records only. Never invent titles, pages, links, venues, counts, citations or timings.
For a verified PDF-backed claim, provide paper identifier, section and actual page and table/figure when available; otherwise state citation granularity truthfully.
A deep-link of the form #page=N is allowed only when the source PDF URL and PDF page index are verified, and printed page numbering may differ.
Mark each factual field as reported, API-observed, derived, model-inferred, conflicting, unknown or not_reported as applicable.
Attach provenance: source ID, provider/time or PDF hash + page/section/span/table, extraction version, and verification status.
Distinct pipelines: topic relevance ranking, paper-quality or research utility evidence, and library/book matching must not be conflated.
Citation count, h-index, g-index, i10-index and m-index are source- and time-specific; unavailable metrics must remain unknown, not estimated silently.
For numerical comparisons, retain dataset, split, metric direction, hardware, inference precision, evaluation protocol and units before claiming superiority.
Label author claims as claims unless separately verified; graph relation types such as CONTRADICTS require explicit cross-paper comparability checks.
Use normally 5–10 surfaced papers from a canonical retained candidate pool of up to 100 (configurable to 500); do not claim to have retrieved more than returned.
Do not block legitimate research, software, or academic questions with an unconditional procedural denial or arbitrary topical cosine-score threshold.
When rights prohibit full text, answer from permitted metadata/abstract with a clear limitation; never fabricate extracted full-text evidence.
Prefer concise default answers; expand for comparison, deep paper reading, literature review, or requests for a thorough explanation.
Internal extraction/model or ranker confidence must not be presented as a calibrated probability unless validated on representative data.
